headline: Review of provisional ballots cast at the November 3, 2026 General Election.
summary: Members will review provisional ballots cast in the November 3, 2026 General Election. Votes may be taken on them.
items: Review provisional ballots cast at the November 3, 2026 General Election
location: Board of Canvassers, Pawtucket City Hall, 137 Roosevelt Ave. Pawtucket, RI
